te: Thai–Chinese cooperation on disasters followed up, and the veterans forum renamed
se: The meeting noted matters approved by the committee: inviting the Armed Forces Development Command and the Army Engineer Department to discuss a Thai–Chinese cooperation mechanism on HADR, a report of discussions at the Embassy of China, a letter asking the government to support special allowances for forces serving in combat, and an academic forum with Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University and the War Veterans Organization of Thailand, renamed "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade"
it: Follow-up matters from the committee's meeting
Academic forum "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade"

te: Committee approves the letter asking the government to support personnel allowances, and the veterans forum
se: The meeting noted that the committee had approved inviting the Armed Forces Development Command and the Army Engineer Department to discuss Thai–Chinese military cooperation on humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) on 28 January 2026, and had approved the report of discussions with the Chinese side, a letter asking the government to support special allowances for forces serving in combat on the Thai–Cambodian border, and the academic forum project on veterans
it: Outcome of the committee's meeting on HADR cooperation and special allowances for personnel
Academic forum project "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade"

te: More advisers appointed, and the report of discussions with the Chinese Ambassador and the report on special allowances considered
se: The meeting noted the outcome of discussions with the Chinese side, following which it will propose that the committee invite the Armed Forces Development Command and the Army Engineer Department to discuss Thai–Chinese cooperation on disasters. It noted the Minister of Defence's policy for fiscal year 2026, and considered appointing more advisers, the draft report of discussions at the Embassy of China, and the report on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations
it: Appointment of additional advisers to the subcommittee and working groups
Draft report of the discussions held at the Embassy of the People's Republic of China
Report on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations

te: Discussions with the Chinese Ambassador prepared, and a special payment for personnel serving on the border proposed
se: The meeting noted the schedule for discussions with the Ambassador and the Defence Attaché of the People's Republic of China to Thailand on 8 January 2026, and considered proposals on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations. As an urgent measure, it proposed a one-off special payment for the period July–December 2025, and a working group to study adjusting personnel entitlements in the long term
it: Schedule of discussions with the Ambassador and the Defence Attaché of China to Thailand
Special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations

te: Invitation to donate blood for flood victims and people affected by the border situation
se: The meeting noted a blood donation activity to help flood victims and people affected by the situation on the Thai–Cambodian border on 24 December 2025 at Parliament House, and invited committee members, advisers, subcommittee members and staff to take part
it: Blood donation activity for flood victims and people affected by the border situation

te: Subcommittee assigned to study the draft policy for the southern border provinces, 2025–2027
se: The meeting noted the draft Policy on the Administration and Development of the Southern Border Provinces B.E. 2568–2570 (2025–2027), approved by the Council of Ministers as proposed by the Office of the National Security Council and submitted to the National Assembly for information, and assigned the Subcommittee on Holistic Security to prepare observations and recommendations for the debate in the Senate
it: Draft Policy on the Administration and Development of the Southern Border Provinces B.E. 2568–2570 (2025–2027)

te: Representative sent to take part in considering the draft law on teachers and educational personnel
se: The meeting assigned the Third Vice-Chair of the committee as its representative on the ad hoc committee considering the draft Teachers and Educational Personnel Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., and considered other matters
it: Representative on the ad hoc committee considering the draft Teachers and Educational Personnel Act

te: Agencies heard on the management of migration
se: The meeting considered approaches to managing migration at the national level in Thailand so that it does not affect security, inviting representatives of the Office of the National Security Council, ISOC and the Ministry of Interior to give information
it: Approaches to managing migration at the national level

te: A former 2th Army Area Commander to be heard on the border situation
se: The meeting noted that the former 2th Army Area Commander, who had been invited to exchange views on the situation and trends on the Thai–Cambodian border, had another engagement, so a new date will be set. It also noted a matter from the Committee on Constitutional Independent Organisations
it: Invitation to the former 2th Army Area Commander to exchange views on the situation on the Thai–Cambodian border

te: Representatives sent to ad hoc committees considering draft laws
se: The meeting assigned representatives of the committee to serve on ad hoc committees considering draft Acts already approved by the House of Representatives (Constitution, section 136), such as the draft Act on Expropriation and Acquisition of Immovable Property and the draft Act on Building a Peaceful Society
it: Representatives of the committee on ad hoc committees considering draft laws

te: Subcommittee assigned to prepare views on the draft military courts law
se: The meeting assigned the Subcommittee on Military Affairs to prepare information to support academic views on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. ...., and considered the recommendations of the Senate sitting on 23 September 2025
it: Information to support academic views on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts
Recommendations of the Senate sitting of 23 September 2025

te: Representative sent to a seminar on the future of Thai TV, and other matters
se: The meeting noted an invitation to the seminar "The Future of Thai TV: New Options amid Challenges" held by the Senate Committee on Information Technology, Communications and Telecommunications on 17 October 2025, and assigned the committee secretary as its representative
it: Invitation to the seminar on the future of Thai TV

te: Forum "Thailand's Position in the Context of Lawfare" prepared
se: The meeting noted the preparations for the academic forum "Thailand's Position in the Context of Lawfare amid Changes in Global Geopolitics" that afternoon, and considered changes of positions in the committee
it: Academic forum: Thailand's position in the context of lawfare amid changes in global geopolitics
Changes of positions in the committee

te: A private company permitted to present on frigates, and the work report planned
se: The meeting approved a request from a private company to present information on anti-submarine frigates to the committee on 16 October 2025, and considered the plan for preparing the committee's work report for the period 1 April – 30 September 2025
it: Request to present information on anti-submarine frigates
Plan for preparing the work report for April–September 2025

te: Agencies' statements of facts on border disputes considered
se: The meeting resolved to draw up a common agreement on members' leave from meetings, assigned the Chair of the committee as its representative on the Senate Committee on Ethics for 2026, and considered the statements of facts submitted by the agencies summoned concerning their position and approach on disputes in Thailand's border areas
it: Common agreement on members' leave from meetings
Representative of the committee on the Senate Committee on Ethics
Statements of facts on the position and approach concerning disputes in border areas

te: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Department of Mineral Fuels give information on Ko Kut
se: The meeting considered problems and approaches in enforcing the law on territory, sovereignty, natural resources and national interests concerning the area of overlapping continental shelf claims between Thailand and Cambodia around Ko Kut, inviting representatives of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Department of Mineral Fuels to give information on the main work done
it: Law enforcement concerning the area of overlapping continental shelf claims between Thailand and Cambodia around Ko Kut
